tools.name: context_pack
tools.title: Build Kyro context pack
tools.description: Return the minimal routing/task context an agent should load for a Kyro scope. Use before resuming work or executing a task.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

task_id.description: Optional active sprint task id. Empty string means handoff.nextTaskId.

tools.name: doctor_artifacts
tools.title: Run Kyro artifact doctor
tools.description: Validate Kyro project and scope artifact shape, snapshots, narratives, and clarity markers.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

tools.name: analyze_scope
tools.title: Analyze Kyro scope semantics
tools.description: Run semantic cross-checks for clarity, coverage, dependencies, debt, and project principles.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

tools.name: scope_list
tools.title: List Kyro scopes
tools.description: List known Kyro scopes, their status, and which one is active.

tools.name: scope_inspect
tools.title: Inspect Kyro scope
tools.description: Return artifact doctor checks for one scope.

tools.name: close_sprint
tools.title: Close active Kyro sprint
tools.description: Build or apply the deterministic zero-loss close-sprint plan. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: repair_scope
tools.title: Repair Kyro scope formatting
tools.description: Build or apply a sprint.json normalization plan. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.
